scenarios.title: The pr preflight samples a state branch and the stack preflight does not
scenarios.notes: Run branches.py preflight --mode pr and --mode stack in a scratch repo. The pr samples hold kind state with a name that matches ^sdlc/state-\d{14}$. The timestamp changes per run, so match it with a regex. The stack samples hold no state kind. Also try a custom branchFormat in config: the state name must still follow the format.

scenarios.title: The mr and direct preflights sample no state branch
scenarios.notes: Run preflight --mode mr and --mode direct, with and without --branch. The mr mode adds a working sample when --branch is given. That sample must not carry kind state. Check by kind, not by count.

scenarios.title: The stack preflight samples run and milestone branches and the pr preflight does not
scenarios.notes: In stack mode the names are sdlc/run-1 and sdlc/M-1. In pr mode no sample has kind run or milestone. Try a custom branchFormat and check that both names follow it.

scenarios.title: Only the pr preflight samples an e2e branch
scenarios.notes: pr mode holds kind e2e with name sdlc/M-1-e2e. Stack, mr and direct modes hold no e2e sample.

scenarios.title: No mode samples a kind that the loop never pushes
scenarios.notes: Across pr, stack, mr and direct, no sample has kind e2e-area, verify or attempt. Repeat with hostile --branch values (flag-like, traversal, control characters, unicode confusables) and with a hostile branchFormat. The set of sampled kinds must not change, and the command must not crash.

tools.purpose: Run branches.py preflight from a scratch repo with a controlled environment and read the JSON samples.
Supply hostile --branch values to prove the sampled kinds do not change.

riskReason: The slice adds tests only for a small pure table lookup that S-016 already built, and a wrong result is easy to see.
notes: The slice is a characterization slice. SAMPLE_KINDS in branches.py maps each mode to its sampled kinds. The scenarios map one to one onto the five tests T-R-136a to T-R-137c. The limits profile does not apply, because the spec states no number. The contract profile does not apply, because the observable boundary is the preflight command, not an exported function. Round 1 (after review-fix): the fix deleted five duplicate tests. It changed no observable behavior. No scenario is added.
